mapper.sql: id, user_id, user_name, balance, freeze, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into campus_account (user_id, user_name, balance, freeze) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{balance}, #{freeze})
mapper.select: select from campus_account where user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select from campus_account
and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
order by update_time desc
